answer: In PoA, each challenge is cryptographically bound to a future drand quicknet pulse and its threshold-BLS signature, which is unavailable when the task is issued. A response must commit to, then reveal, work derived from that unpredictable value, preventing sybil swarms from precomputing solutions, reusing cached proofs, or farming identities offline. Whether testing a knoll, ridge, or zephyr, eligibility depends on fresh, auditable beacon entropy.
